Count the almonds: roughly 22 or so. Each almond weighs about 1.2 g, so the total is about 26 g. At about 5.8 kcal/g (almonds run about 579 kcal per 100 g), that comes to roughly 150 kcal.

These look like raw almonds, and some may be broken or halved. I'll estimate 24 g of food.

24 g × 5.8 kcal/g ≈ 139 kcal.
